title: First day · "remind me to call Sara on Friday" is a reminder that fires

steps.say: remind me to call Sara on Friday
steps.reply: I've set a reminder to call Sara on Friday 23 October at 09:00. I picked 09:00 because you didn't give a time. If you'd like a different time, tell me and I'll change it.
steps.routed_by: judge: A reminder for Friday is a schedule that has to stand and fire later, so it can't be finished in this turn, and no open work item covers it.
